_meta.purpose: The TOTAL map from the slice's own filed type string (typeAsFiled, immutable) to the controlled term (typeTerm). TRACKED INPUT — read by scripts/gen-opgraph.mjs; never written by it.
_meta.rule: The generator FAILS HARD on any typeAsFiled string not present here. An unmapped string is never silently passed through and never silently retyped (write-invariant W3g).
_meta.retypeRule: RE-TYPING IS A RESEARCH ACT, NOT A BUILD ACT. Where a correct retype needs the source re-read, the row keeps the COARSE PARENT term and carries retypePending:true with retypeTarget naming an existing controlled term. The generator never applies a retype.
_meta.normalisation: typeAsFiled is matched byte-for-byte after NFC normalisation only. Diacritics and slashes are preserved in the key exactly as the slice wrote them.

retypePending.why: Slice 11's own §6 argument: the PGM's core act is reciting a logos of voces magicae and vowel chains copied verbatim in the handbook, which 'invocation-evocation' loses. The retype is correct but needs the source re-read row by row, so the rows keep the coarse parent and name the target.

endpointMap._note: Bare and prefixed procedure-type strings used as CONTAINS_PROCEDURE edge TARGETS in the slices. These endpoints are consumed by the claim machinery (work -> procedure-claim -> OF_TYPE -> procedure-type); the raw CONTAINS_PROCEDURE edge is never emitted. Listed here so an unmapped endpoint is still a hard failure rather than a silent drop.

harmMap._note: Total map from the slice's own harm string to the closed harm-kind enum (PLAN §2.6). The generator fails on an unmapped harm string. DEVIATION FROM PLAN §2.6, DECLARED: the plan's enum has 14 terms and does not cover 'psychological-destabilisation', which 8 rows in slices 12 and 14 type explicitly (ecstatic letter-permutation, Hekhalot adjuration, the Abramelin ordeal). Rather than launder those rows into 'ascetic-fasting' or drop the signal, the enum is extended to 15 and the addition is printed by the artery and named in OPGRAPH_META.harmKindsAddedByData.

harmKindGlosses._note: STANDING GLOSSES WRITTEN BY THIS REPO, not statements taken from a source. Used only where a slice typed a hazard class but wrote no note; the claim then carries harmNoteDerived: true so the difference is never invisible. Every gloss is descriptive and third-person by construction (FRAMING §3: grammatical mood is the criterion).
harmKindGlosses.toxic-substance: The materia named in this class includes documented poisons. The tradition's own harm literature is part of the record; the preparation is not.
harmKindGlosses.animal-killing: The rite as attested involves killing an animal. Recorded as historical practice, with the ethical register left visible rather than absorbed into a neutral offering term.
harmKindGlosses.hypoxia-breath-retention: Breath retention carries a documented hypocapnia mechanism: loss of consciousness can arrive without prodrome. No timing or ratio is recorded here.
harmKindGlosses.sleep-deprivation: The regimen as attested restricts sleep. Recorded as a stage kind only.
harmKindGlosses.ascetic-fasting: The regimen as attested restricts food or drink over a bounded period. Durations, meal patterns and permitted classes are not recorded (razor strike R1).
harmKindGlosses.self-injury: The text as attested directs a self-inflicted injury. No instrument, body site or technique is recorded (FRAMING C-4).
harmKindGlosses.coercion-of-a-named-person: The target of such a rite is by definition a non-consenting named person. Recorded, never reproduced, and never with a substitution slot beside a sequence (FRAMING C-5).
harmKindGlosses.ritual-aggression: A hostile rite. Its documented modern harm falls overwhelmingly on the accused and the defrauded, not on the operator.
harmKindGlosses.allegory-misread-as-recipe: The text is safer than its readership was: the historical harm came from readers taking its emblems literally, which the text itself rejects.
harmKindGlosses.fire-hazard: The rite as attested involves open fire or a sealed heated vessel.
harmKindGlosses.mortuary-sensitivity: The material concerns the dead, graves or funerary deposition, and is handled as such.
harmKindGlosses.living-tradition-sensitivity: This material is practised now. The graph maps structure and names what is withheld; it does not characterise the withheld content.
harmKindGlosses.sectarian-defamation-risk: This material has a documented history of use in sectarian polemic against the community that carries it.
harmKindGlosses.reception-distortion: The reception history distorts the text: what circulates under this title is substantially not what the text says.
harmKindGlosses.psychological-destabilisation: The practices in this class are attested as producing disorientation, altered states or acute distress, and the tradition's own literature records that.
